table.name: CAN Telemetry at Startup
table.description: Exact JK00D producer configuration. Disabled is the default. A validated START command on the derived control CAN ID overrides this byte until reset; STOP forces streaming off until reset. Requires the project CAN telemetry runtime.

table.name: Developer Immobilizer
table.description: Exact JK00D only. Bit 0 enables ECM immobilizer enforcement. Vehicle start and operation verified. NATS DTC suppression is independent.

table.name: Rolling Launch Require Accelerator Pedal
table.description: Exact JK00D. Enabled writes min_pedal=1 and requires a nonzero normalized accelerator-pedal signal for activation. Disabled writes min_pedal=0, which makes the pedal gate unconditional. The signal is not presented as a calibrated pedal percentage.

table.name: Rolling Launch Enable by Map
table.description: Exact JK00D. Each checkbox independently enables Rolling Launch for one map and preserves the other bits. Bits 5 through 7 must remain clear; the runtime rejects the configuration otherwise.
